items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: Did he take many solos? Yeah, most all of them take me solo.

ctx.x: We knew what he was in the name. I'm talking about.
Willie Cornish, did you know him? Cornish, Cornish, yeah. Big Cornish.
Yeah, yeah. Did he take many solos? Yeah, most all of them take me solo. They were now.
